contexts.text: Wives who do not love their husbands... are represented by a cock, etc. SE 3198.
Before the cock crew = before a new Church should come into existence.
The time when the cock was crowing = the last state of the Church; which time is also called the cockcrowing.
That cockcrowing and dawn are the same thing...

The reason cocks display such jealousy, is that they are vain-glorious lovers, and the glory of that love cannot endure an equal; that they are vain-glorious lovers, above every species of bird, appears from their gestures, nods, gait, and the sounds they make.
The first (of the two states of regeneration) may be compared to dawn or cockcrowing.
Some say it is a cock; others an owl.
Before the cock crew, he should deny Him thrice = that at the last time of the Church there would be no faith, because no charity; for cockcrowing equally with dawn = the last time of the Church.
The cockcrowing, or dawn () = a state of commencing faith and charity, which exists when man loves truths, and reformation through them.
